<thought>We need to determine how many methyl (CH₃) groups are present in the compound of the sample. The most direct way is to retrieve the 13C NMR spectrum for the sample, which will show carbon signals. Methyl carbons typically appear in the upfield region (~10–30 ppm). By counting the number of distinct signals in that region we can infer the number of CH₃ groups. We'll request the carbon NMR spectrum for the sample.</thought>
